title: Camera Distance 2.9.9: co-op look-ahead pull-back, marker hidden over menus
intro: Needs Camera Distance 2.9.9 with Couch Co-op Framing on, DPC 0.9.170-dev14. Co-op off, playing the Arisen, open flat ground with room ahead, no enemies. The robot plays player 2. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

steps.text: Get ready: open flat ground with lots of room in front of the camera. Press End to start.
Starting co-op on the main pawn (the robot is player 2). Stand still as the Arisen.
Look-ahead OFF: the robot runs player 2 straight ahead. Watch how far the camera pulls back.
Now open the REFramework menu (Insert) > Camera Distance > 'Couch co-op fine tuning' and set 'Fit: pull back per metre player 2 is ahead' to 0.35. Close the menu, then press End.
Look-ahead ON: the same run. Does the camera pull back sooner / more?
If the edge marker for player 2 shows (or once player 2 is off screen), press Esc to open the menu: the marker should vanish while the menu is open. Close the menu again. Press End when done.
Co-op off. Set the look-ahead slider back to 0 (same place) if you don't want it. Press End when done.
Done. Tell Claude: did look-ahead pull back more, and did the marker hide over the menu?
